Placed in the robot datum with the HUB centre at (-3100, -2000) mm for the acquire pose (2.7 m shot offset less the acquire offset); cases move it with the robot-relative field motion.
Field fixture, FRC 2026 V0 HUB top plate: 1193.8 mm square from 1779 to 1828.8 mm with the same hexagonal opening (geometry.py field_bodies). Placed with the HUB body.

Field fixture, FRC 2026 V0 TOWER BASE: 39.0 x 45.18 in plate, 8 mm edges, front edge 4.6 mm ahead of the uprights (geometry.py field_bodies). Placed with the TOWER face at x = 625 mm, centre y = -3250 mm for the acquire pose; tower cases move it.
Field fixture, FRC 2026 V0 TOWER low rung: 42.164 mm tube at 685.8 mm centre height spanning the 819.15 mm upright gap (geometry.py field_bodies). Placed with the TOWER.
Field fixture, FRC 2026 V0 TOWER upright: 88.9 x 38.1 mm section, 9.5 to 1831.3 mm (geometry.py field_bodies). Placed with the TOWER.
Field fixture, FRC 2026 V0 TOWER upright: 88.9 x 38.1 mm section, 9.5 to 1831.3 mm (geometry.py field_bodies). Placed with the TOWER.
